question: What natural image illustrates a state of hardened immobility?
premises: Snowfall can cover the earth on all sides.
When joined with the wind, that covering becomes hard like stone.
The image presents a state of persistent rigidity.
inference: The verse uses the snow-and-wind image to depict a condition that becomes fixed and immobile, preparing the comparison in the next verse.
uncertainties: The exact doctrinal referent of the simile is completed only in verse 544.
plain_english: Just as the earth, covered on all sides by falling snow, becomes hard like stone through contact with the wind and remains so, so too a certain state becomes fixed.
